test.name: Out-of-scope request — decline, search nothing, write nothing
test.description: The delegation carries a request entirely outside the genealogy toolkit's scope. The agent must recognise it is not an encyclopedia article lookup, decline in one sentence, and neither call wikipedia_search nor save a file — it must not coerce the request into a lookup ('look up CSV on Wikipedia' is a contorted reading that ignores the actual ask). Converted from a routed out-of-scope negative to a direct decline test on the lead's ruling of 2026-09-24 (issue #2795): with the skill deleted there is no router, and a direct negative has no defined outcome path — `activated` is derived from the spawn plus a substantive reply, and the agent's return contract makes every reply substantive, so a routed `correct_skill: []` reading would abort `skill not found` and an activation reading would be vacuous. The verdict is therefore the deterministic no-harm invariant plus the judge's base dimensions. The 'wikipedia-search-any' fixture stays declared so the zero-calls assertion is falsifiable and is expected to go UNUSED (#1788, #1662 finding F6). Do not remove it as an unused fixture.

input.delegation: Help me write a Python function that parses a CSV file

judge_context: The agent should decline: the request is outside the genealogy toolkit's scope and must not be coerced into an encyclopedia lookup. It has no lane to hand this back to - historical-context, locality-guide and search-familysearch-wiki are all genealogy lanes and none owns a programming question - so a plain decline is the whole correct answer and naming another agent would be wrong.

A no-wiki-no-write invariant validator also runs on this test: no wikipedia_search call and no saved .md file. The registered fixture exists only to make that clause falsifiable; do not read it as a hint that a lookup is expected.
Two short sentences are the correct length - the scope is stated and what the agent does handle is named. Do not penalize brevity, and do not expect a summary of anything.
